description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Translation' within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically in the Catalog Model for Design. It provides a method to retrieve translation records from the database based on a given route.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: A model class responsible for fetching translation records from the database based on a route in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves translation entries from the database that match the specified route, considering current store and language settings.
